blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines sees action in the Asian Games 2026 triathlon competitions in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Races will be held at the Gamagori City Triathlon Venue in Aichi Prefecture. The triathlon team of the Philippines is composed of Fernando Casares, Inaki Lorbes, Kim Mangrobang, Raven Alcoseba and Andrew Kim Remolino.
